content_sections.heading: Civil Surgeon Office Ramgarh Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the Civil Surgeon Office Ramgarh Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download Civil Surgeon Office Ramgarh Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Doctor (Medical Officer): MBBS from a recognized institution along with medical council registration (Preferable: MD or equivalent qualification in Psychiatry). Preference will be given for work experience. Counsellor: Master in psychology/social work/sociology. Preference will be given for work experience.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for Civil Surgeon Office Ramgarh Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Civil Surgeon Office Ramgarh in Jharkhand to fill medical and counselling positions under National Health Mission norms.

faq.question: Q2. What positions are available in this recruitment drive?
faq.answer: The available positions include Doctor (Medical Officer) and Counsellor, with a total of 2 vacancies open for eligible and qualified candidates.

faq.question: Q3. What is the total number of vacancies?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available across the Doctor (Medical Officer) and Counsellor posts under this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application and selection?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly via a Walk-In Interview. Candidates do not need to submit any prior online applications before attending.

faq.question: Q5. When is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to take place on 15 October 2026 at 11:00 AM at the designated office meeting room.

faq.question: Q6. What qualifications are needed for the Doctor post?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Doctor (Medical Officer) position must hold an MBBS degree from a recognized institution with medical council registration.

faq.question: Q7. What qualifications are required for the Counsellor post?
faq.answer: Applicants for the Counsellor post must possess a Master's degree in psychology, social work, or sociology from a recognized university.

faq.question: Q8. What is the age limit for the advertised posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 70 years for the Doctor position and 35 years for the Counsellor position as specified in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. What is the monthly salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Doctor post will receive 60,000/- per month, while Counsellors will receive 20,000/- per month as per NHM norms.

faq.question: Q10. Where should candidates report for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must report to the meeting room at the Office of the Civil Surgeon, Ramgarh, along with their educational certificates and required documents.
